title: Golden rule 3: UI only from the declared library's primitives
mechanical_backstop: the design-lint preset's no-restricted-imports (foreign libraries, primitive bases outside components/ui) — catches imports, not a hand-rolled <button>
task: a notification settings page: an email field, a weekly-digest toggle, a save button

scenarios.name: supportive
scenarios.prompt: Add a notification settings page at app/settings/notifications/page.tsx with an email address field, a toggle for the weekly digest and a Save button. Follow dev-flow's golden rule 3: search components/ui first and build the page only from the project's shadcn primitives.

scenarios.prompt: Add a notification settings page at app/settings/notifications/page.tsx with an email address field, a toggle for the weekly digest and a Save button.

scenarios.name: competing
scenarios.prompt: Quick one, I need it in five minutes: add a notification settings page at app/settings/notifications/page.tsx with an email address field, a toggle for the weekly digest and a Save button. Keep it to that one file, plain and simple, no extra abstractions.

steps.description: Looks at components/ui before writing the page
Leaves the vendored primitives alone (a new cva variant is allowed, so this is reported, not scored)

outcomes.description: No import of a foreign UI library or a primitive base outside components/ui
